problems.name: imo1959_p1
problems.text: Prove that the fraction (21n+4)/(14n+3) is irreducible for every natural number n.
problems.notes: irreducible = the greatest common divisor is 1; natural number = integer >= 0 (the statement is true for every integer)
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.is_gcd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XI (XO XH))))) * x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH)))) (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XI (XI XH)))) * x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) Z.one

problems.name: sqrt2_irrational
problems.text: Prove that sqrt(2) is irrational: there are no integers p, q with q /= 0 and p^2 = 2 q^2.
problems.notes: irrational = not a quotient of two integers with a non-zero denominator; the reference proof is a descent by strong induction on q
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Not (x1 = Z.zero) -> Not (x0 * x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * (x1 * x1))

problems.name: imo2019_p1
problems.text: Let Z be the set of integers. Determine all functions f : Z -> Z such that f(2a) + 2f(b) = f(f(a+b)) for all integers a and b.
problems.answer: f(n) = 0 for all n, and f(n) = 2n + c for all n, for any integer c
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence: f satisfies the equation iff f is the zero function or f(n) = 2n + c for some c
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), (forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1) + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0 x2 = x0 (x0 (x1 + x2))) <-> (forall (x1 : Z), x0 x1 = Z.zero) \/ Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => forall (x2 : Z), x0 x2 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x2 + x1)

problems.name: ident_diff_squares
problems.text: For all integers a and b: (a + b)(a - b) = a^2 - b^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (x0 + x1) * (x0 - x1) = x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) - x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ident_sophie_germain
problems.text: For all integers a and b: a^4 + 4 b^4 = (a^2 + 2ab + 2b^2)(a^2 - 2ab + 2b^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x1 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) = ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0) * x1) + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) - (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0) * x1) + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: ident_brahmagupta
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c, d: (a^2 + b^2)(c^2 + d^2) = (ac - bd)^2 + (ad + bc)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) * (x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x3 ^ Npos (XO XH)) = (x0 * x2 - x1 * x3) ^ Npos (XO XH) + (x0 * x3 + x1 * x2) ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ident_consecutive_four
problems.text: For every integer n: n(n+1)(n+2)(n+3) + 1 = (n^2 + 3n + 1)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), ((x0 * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))) * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)))) * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) + Z.of_N (Npos XH) = ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x0) + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ident_fourth_powers
problems.text: For all integers a and b: a^4 + b^4 + (a + b)^4 = 2 (a^2 + ab + b^2)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + x1 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))) + (x0 + x1) ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x0 * x1) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ineq_am_gm_two
problems.text: For all integers a and b: 2ab <= a^2 + b^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0) * x1 <= x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ineq_square_sum_three
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: ab + bc + ca <= a^2 + b^2 + c^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), (x0 * x1 + x1 * x2) + x2 * x0 <= (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ineq_four_ab
problems.text: For all integers a and b: 4ab <= (a + b)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x0) * x1 <= (x0 + x1) ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ineq_cauchy_two
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c, d: (ac + bd)^2 <= (a^2 + b^2)(c^2 + d^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), (x0 * x2 + x1 * x3) ^ Npos (XO XH) <= (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) * (x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x3 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: sum_squares_zero
problems.text: If a and b are integers with a^2 + b^2 = 0, then a = 0 and b = 0.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.zero -> x0 = Z.zero /\ x1 = Z.zero

problems.name: not_dvd_between
problems.text: Let d > 0 and k be integers. No multiple of d lies strictly between dk and d(k+1): if dk < x < d(k+1) then d does not divide x.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero < x0 -> x0 * x1 < x2 -> x2 < x0 * (x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) -> Not (Z.dvd x0 x2)

problems.name: square_mod_four
problems.text: The square of every integer is of the form 4k or 4k + 1.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x1 \/ x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: sum_two_squares_mod4
problems.text: No integer of the form 4k + 3 is a sum of two squares: a^2 + b^2 /= 4k + 3 for all integers a, b, k.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Not (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x2 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)))

problems.name: odd_square_mod_eight
problems.text: The square of an odd integer leaves remainder 1 upon division by 8.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) -> Ex Z (fun (x2 : Z) => x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO XH)))) * x2 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: cube_mod_nine
problems.text: The cube of every integer is of the form 9k, 9k + 1 or 9k + 8.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XO XH)))) * x1 \/ (x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XO XH)))) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH) \/ x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XO XH)))) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO XH))))))

problems.name: cube_minus_n_div6
problems.text: For every integer n, 6 divides n^3 - n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XI XH)))) (x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) - x0)

problems.name: pow_sub_dvd
problems.text: For integers a, b and every natural number n, a - b divides a^n - b^n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : N), Z.dvd (x0 - x1) (x0 ^ x2 - x1 ^ x2)

problems.name: coprime_consecutive
problems.text: Consecutive integers are coprime: gcd(n, n + 1) = 1 for every integer n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.is_gcd x0 (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) Z.one

problems.name: no_square_between
problems.text: There is no perfect square strictly between n^2 and (n + 1)^2: for integers n >= 0 and m, it is not the case that n^2 < m^2 < (n + 1)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Not (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) < x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) /\ x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) < (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: three_dvd_sum_squares
problems.text: If 3 divides a^2 + b^2 for integers a and b, then 3 divides both a and b.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) -> Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) x0 /\ Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) x1

problems.name: N.induction3
problems.text: Induction in steps of three: if P(0), P(1) and P(2) hold, and P(m) implies P(m + 3) for every natural number m, then P(n) holds for every natural number n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N -> Prop), forall (x1 : N), x0 N0 -> x0 (N.succ N0) -> x0 (N.succ (N.succ N0)) -> (forall (x5 : N), x0 x5 -> x0 (N.succ (N.succ (N.succ x5)))) -> x0 x1

problems.name: imo1984_p2
problems.text: Find two positive integers a and b such that none of the numbers a, b, a + b is divisible by 7 and (a + b)^7 - a^7 - b^7 is divisible by 7^7.
problems.answer: a = 18, b = 1 (and the pairs equivalent to it modulo 7^3)
problems.statement: Ex Z (fun (x0 : Z) => Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => Z.zero < x0 /\ (Z.zero < x1 /\ (Not (Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH)))) x0) /\ (Not (Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH)))) x1) /\ (Not (Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH)))) (x0 + x1)) /\ Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH))) ^ Npos (XI (XI XH))) (((x0 + x1) ^ Npos (XI (XI XH)) - x0 ^ Npos (XI (XI XH))) - x1 ^ Npos (XI (XI XH)))))))))

problems.name: imo1969_p1
problems.text: Prove that there exist infinitely many positive integers a such that n^4 + a is not a prime number for any positive integer n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Ex Z (fun (x2 : Z) => x0 < x2 /\ (forall (x3 : Z), Z.zero < x3 -> Not (Z.prime (x3 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + x2))))

problems.name: imo1964_p1b
problems.text: Prove that there is no positive integer n for which 2^n + 1 is divisible by 7.
problems.notes: the powers of 2 leave the remainders 1, 2, 4 upon division by 7 (the lemma pow2_mod7); positivity of n is not needed
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N), N0 < x0 -> Not (Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH)))) (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) ^ x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)))

problems.name: imo1964_p1a
problems.text: Find all positive integers n for which 2^n - 1 is divisible by 7.
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence of the condition with the answer: 7 divides 2^n - 1 iff 3 divides n; the proof is an induction in steps of three
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N), N0 < x0 -> Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH)))) (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) ^ x0 - Z.of_N (Npos XH)) <-> Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) (Z.of_N x0)

problems.name: ident_cube_sum
problems.text: For all integers a and b: a^3 + b^3 = (a + b)(a^2 - ab + b^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH) = (x0 + x1) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) - x0 * x1) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: ident_cube_diff
problems.text: For all integers a and b: a^3 - b^3 = (a - b)(a^2 + ab + b^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) - x1 ^ Npos (XI XH) = (x0 - x1) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x0 * x1) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: ident_three_cubes
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: a^3 + b^3 + c^3 - 3abc = (a + b + c)(a^2 + b^2 + c^2 - ab - bc - ca).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), ((x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XI XH)) - ((Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x0) * x1) * x2 = ((x0 + x1) + x2) * (((((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)) - x0 * x1) - x1 * x2) - x2 * x0)

problems.name: ident_pell_product
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c, d: (a^2 - 2b^2)(c^2 - 2d^2) = (ac + 2bd)^2 - 2(ad + bc)^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) - Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) * (x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) - Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x3 ^ Npos (XO XH)) = (x0 * x2 + (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1) * x3) ^ Npos (XO XH) - Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * (x0 * x3 + x1 * x2) ^ Npos (XO XH)

problems.name: ineq_three_squares
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: (a + b + c)^2 <= 3(a^2 + b^2 + c^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), ((x0 + x1) + x2) ^ Npos (XO XH) <= Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: ineq_shifted_squares
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: a^2 + b^2 + c^2 + 3 >= 2(a + b + c).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * ((x0 + x1) + x2) <= ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))

problems.name: ineq_cross_terms
problems.text: For all integers x and y: x^2 + y^2 + 1 >= xy + x + y.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (x0 * x1 + x0) + x1 <= (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + Z.of_N (Npos XH)

problems.name: ineq_cubes_two
problems.text: For all integers a, b >= 0: a^3 + b^3 >= a^2 b + a b^2.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) * x1 + x0 * x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) <= x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH)

problems.name: ineq_cubes_three
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c >= 0: a^3 + b^3 + c^3 >= 3abc.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> Z.zero <= x2 -> ((Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x0) * x1) * x2 <= (x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XI XH)

problems.name: ineq_pairs_eight
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c >= 0: (a + b)(b + c)(c + a) >= 8abc.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> Z.zero <= x2 -> ((Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO XH)))) * x0) * x1) * x2 <= ((x0 + x1) * (x1 + x2)) * (x2 + x0)

problems.name: ineq_fourth_powers_three
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: a^4 + b^4 + c^4 >= abc(a + b + c).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), ((x0 * x1) * x2) * ((x0 + x1) + x2) <= (x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + x1 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))) + x2 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))

problems.name: ineq_four_fourth_powers
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c, d: a^4 + b^4 + c^4 + d^4 >= 4abcd.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), (((Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x0) * x1) * x2) * x3 <= ((x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + x1 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))) + x2 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))) + x3 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH))

problems.name: quad_form_zero
problems.text: If a and b are integers with a^2 + ab + b^2 = 0, then a = 0 and b = 0.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x0 * x1) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.zero -> x0 = Z.zero /\ x1 = Z.zero

problems.name: square_mod_three
problems.text: The square of every integer is of the form 3k or 3k + 1.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x1 \/ x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: consecutive_product_even
problems.text: The product of two consecutive integers is even: 2 divides n(n + 1) for every integer n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH))) (x0 * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)))

problems.name: three_consecutive_div3
problems.text: The product of three consecutive integers is divisible by 3: 3 divides n(n + 1)(n + 2) for every integer n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) ((x0 * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))) * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH))))

problems.name: five_dvd_fifth_power
problems.text: For every integer n, 5 divides n^5 - n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO XH)))) (x0 ^ Npos (XI (XO XH)) - x0)

problems.name: fourth_power_odd_16
problems.text: The fourth power of an odd integer leaves remainder 1 upon division by 16: if n is odd then 16 divides n^4 - 1.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) -> Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO (XO XH)))))) (x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) - Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: diff_squares_not_2_mod_4
problems.text: No integer of the form 4k + 2 is a difference of two squares: x^2 - y^2 /= 4k + 2 for all integers x, y, k.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Not (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) - x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * x2 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)))

problems.name: pythag_three
problems.text: In a Pythagorean triple a^2 + b^2 = c^2 of integers, one of a, b is divisible by 3.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) -> Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) x0 \/ Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) x1

problems.name: cube_sum_not_4_mod_9
problems.text: No integer of the form 9k + 4 is a sum of three cubes: x^3 + y^3 + z^3 /= 9k + 4 for all integers x, y, z, k.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), Not ((x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XI XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XO XH)))) * x3 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))))

problems.name: gcd_shift
problems.text: If gcd(a, b) = 1 then gcd(a, b + ka) = 1 for every integer k.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.is_gcd x0 x1 Z.one -> Z.is_gcd x0 (x1 + x2 * x0) Z.one

problems.name: gcd_sum_product
problems.text: If gcd(a, b) = 1 then gcd(a + b, ab) = 1.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.is_gcd x0 x1 Z.one -> Z.is_gcd (x0 + x1) (x0 * x1) Z.one

problems.name: dvd_coprime_product
problems.text: If a divides c, b divides c and gcd(a, b) = 1, then ab divides c.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.is_gcd x0 x1 Z.one -> Z.dvd x0 x2 -> Z.dvd x1 x2 -> Z.dvd (x0 * x1) x2

problems.name: square_not_prime
problems.text: A perfect square is never a prime: for every integer n, n^2 is not prime.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Not (Z.prime (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH)))

problems.name: no_square_pronic
problems.text: The product of two consecutive positive integers is never a perfect square: n(n + 1) /= m^2 for integers n > 0 and m.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero < x0 -> Not (x0 * (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) = x1 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: five_dvd_six_pow_minus_one
problems.text: For every natural number n, 5 divides 6^n - 1.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO XH)))) (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XI XH))) ^ x0 - Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: three_dvd_four_pow_plus_five
problems.text: For every natural number n, 3 divides 4^n + 5.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) ^ x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO XH))))

problems.name: two_pow_gt_n
problems.text: For every natural number n, n < 2^n.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : N), Z.of_N x0 < Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) ^ x0

problems.name: bernoulli_int
problems.text: Bernoulli's inequality: for every integer x >= -1 and every natural number n, (1 + x)^n >= 1 + n x.
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : N), Z.neg (Z.of_N (Npos XH)) <= x0 -> Z.of_N (Npos XH) + Z.of_N x1 * x0 <= (Z.of_N (Npos XH) + x0) ^ x1

problems.name: three_consecutive_not_squarefree
problems.text: Prove that there are three consecutive positive integers, each of which is divisible by the square of an integer greater than 1.
problems.statement: Ex Z (fun (x0 : Z) => Z.zero < x0 /\ (Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => Z.one < x1 /\ Z.dvd (x1 * x1) x0) /\ (Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => Z.one < x1 /\ Z.dvd (x1 * x1) (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))) /\ Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => Z.one < x1 /\ Z.dvd (x1 * x1) (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)))))))

problems.name: find_all_x2_eq_x
problems.text: Find all integers x with x^2 = x.
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence of the equation with the answer
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), x0 * x0 = x0 <-> x0 = Z.zero \/ x0 = Z.one

problems.name: find_all_xy_eq_x_plus_y
problems.text: Find all pairs of integers (x, y) with xy = x + y.
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence of the equation with the answer; (x - 1)(y - 1) = 1 makes x - 1 a unit
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), x0 * x1 = x0 + x1 <-> x0 = Z.zero /\ x1 = Z.zero \/ x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) /\ x1 = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: find_all_n_plus_1_dvd
problems.text: Find all positive integers n such that n + 1 divides n^2 + 1.
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence of the divisibility with the answer; n + 1 divides n^2 + 1 - (n + 1)(n - 1) = 2
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.zero < x0 -> Z.dvd (x0 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) <-> x0 = Z.of_N (Npos XH)

problems.name: frobenius_3_5
problems.text: Prove that every integer n >= 8 can be written as 3a + 5b with integers a, b >= 0.
problems.notes: strong induction from 8: the cases 8, 9, 10 by hand, and n - 3 >= 8 otherwise
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO XH)))) <= x0 -> Ex Z (fun (x2 : Z) => Ex Z (fun (x3 : Z) => Z.zero <= x2 /\ (Z.zero <= x3 /\ x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x2 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO XH))) * x3)))

problems.name: fe_additive
problems.text: Determine all functions f : Z -> Z such that f(x + y) = f(x) + f(y) for all integers x and y.
problems.answer: f(n) = c n for an integer c
problems.notes: formalised as an equivalence: f is additive iff f(n) = c n for some integer c; the proof is an induction on n in both directions, with c = f(1)
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), (forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 (x1 + x2) = x0 x1 + x0 x2) <-> Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => forall (x2 : Z), x0 x2 = x1 * x2)

problems.name: no_f_f_succ
problems.text: Prove that there is no function f : Z -> Z with f(f(n)) = n + 1 for all integers n.
problems.notes: applying f to the equation gives f(n + 1) = f(n) + 1, so f(n) = n + f(0), and then f(f(0)) = 2 f(0) = 1
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), Not (forall (x1 : Z), x0 (x0 x1) = x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH))

problems.name: sqrt3_irrational
problems.text: Prove that sqrt(3) is irrational: there are no integers p, q with q /= 0 and p^2 = 3 q^2.
problems.notes: descent by strong induction on q >= 0: p^2 = 3 q^2 makes 3 divide p, then q, and p/3, q/3 solve the same equation
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Not (x1 = Z.zero) -> Not (x0 * x0 = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * (x1 * x1))

problems.name: x2_y2_3z2
problems.text: Prove that the only integers x, y, z with x^2 + y^2 = 3 z^2 are x = y = z = 0.
problems.notes: descent by strong induction on z >= 0: 3 divides x^2 + y^2, so x and y; then z^2 = 3 (a^2 + b^2) makes 3 divide z, and (a, b, z/3) solve the same equation
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 * x0 + x1 * x1 = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * (x2 * x2) -> x0 = Z.zero /\ (x1 = Z.zero /\ x2 = Z.zero)

problems.name: pell_infinitely_many
problems.text: Prove that the equation x^2 - 2y^2 = 1 has solutions in integers x, y that are larger than any given bound m >= 0.
problems.notes: from a solution (x, y) the pair (3x + 4y, 2x + 3y) is a larger one: an induction on m from 0, starting at (3, 2)
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Ex Z (fun (x2 : Z) => Ex Z (fun (x3 : Z) => x0 < x2 /\ (x0 < x3 /\ x2 * x2 - Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * (x3 * x3) = Z.one)))

problems.name: no_x2_minus_2y2_eq_3
problems.text: Prove that the equation x^2 - 2y^2 = 3 has no solution in integers.
problems.notes: x^2 + y^2 = 3 (y^2 + 1), so 3 divides x and y, and then 9 divides x^2 - 2y^2 = 3
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Not (x0 * x0 - Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * (x1 * x1) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)))

problems.name: three_squares_mod_eight
problems.text: Prove that no integer of the form 8n + 7 is a sum of three squares: x^2 + y^2 + z^2 /= 8n + 7 for all integers x, y, z, n.
problems.notes: a square is 8k, 8k + 1 or 8k + 4; the 27 combinations leave 8 (a + b + c - n) = 7 - r, which no integer solves: the three cases K < 0, K = 0, K > 0 of K = a + b + c - n close them by linear arithmetic
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), Not ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XO XH)))) * x3 + Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI XH))))

problems.name: schur_nonneg
problems.text: Schur's inequality: for all non-negative integers a, b, c: a(a - b)(a - c) + b(b - a)(b - c) + c(c - a)(c - b) >= 0.
problems.notes: for a >= b >= c the expression is (a - b)^2 (a + b - c) + c (a - c)(b - c); the six orders of a, b, c reduce to it because the expression is symmetric
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> Z.zero <= x2 -> Z.zero <= ((x0 * (x0 - x1)) * (x0 - x2) + (x1 * (x1 - x0)) * (x1 - x2)) + (x2 * (x2 - x0)) * (x2 - x1)

problems.name: ineq_cauchy_three
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c, x, y, z: (ax + by + cz)^2 <= (a^2 + b^2 + c^2)(x^2 + y^2 + z^2).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), forall (x4 : Z), forall (x5 : Z), ((x0 * x3 + x1 * x4) + x2 * x5) ^ Npos (XO XH) <= ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)) * ((x3 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x4 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x5 ^ Npos (XO XH))

problems.name: ineq_chebyshev_cubes
problems.text: For all non-negative integers a, b, c: (a + b + c)(a^2 + b^2 + c^2) <= 3 (a^3 + b^3 + c^3).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> Z.zero <= x2 -> ((x0 + x1) + x2) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)) <= Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * ((x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XI XH))

problems.name: fe_f_x_plus_f_y
problems.text: Determine all functions f : Z -> Z such that f(x + f(y)) = f(x) + y for all integers x and y.
problems.answer: f(n) = n for all n, and f(n) = -n for all n
problems.notes: f(f(y)) = f(0) + y makes f injective, so f(0) = 0 and f(f(y)) = y; replacing y by f(y) makes f additive (fe_additive), so f(n) = c n with c^2 = 1
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), (forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 (x1 + x0 x2) = x0 x1 + x2) <-> (forall (x1 : Z), x0 x1 = x1) \/ (forall (x1 : Z), x0 x1 = Z.neg x1)

problems.name: imo1982_p1
problems.text: The function f(n) is defined for all positive integers n and takes non-negative integer values. Also, for all m, n: f(m + n) - f(m) - f(n) = 0 or 1, and f(2) = 0, f(3) > 0, f(9999) = 3333. Determine f(1982).
problems.notes: f is superadditive, so f(3k) >= k by induction; f(9999) = 3333 forces f(1980) = 660; and f(1982) >= 661 would give f(9999) >= 5 f(1982) + f(89) >= 3334
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), (forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero < x1 -> Z.zero <= x0 x1) -> (forall (x2 : Z), forall (x3 : Z), Z.zero < x2 -> Z.zero < x3 -> x0 (x2 + x3) = x0 x2 + x0 x3 \/ x0 (x2 + x3) = (x0 x2 + x0 x3) + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) -> x0 (Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH))) = Z.zero -> Z.zero < x0 (Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH))) -> x0 (Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XI (XI (XI (XO (XO (XO (XO (XI (XI (XI (XO (XO XH))))))))))))))) = Z.of_N (Npos (XI (XO (XI (XO (XO (XO (XO (XO (XI (XO (XI XH)))))))))))) -> x0 (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XI (XI (XI (XI (XI (XO (XI (XI (XI XH)))))))))))) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO (XI (XO (XI (XO (XO (XI (XO XH))))))))))

problems.name: imo1988_p6
problems.text: Let a and b be positive integers such that ab + 1 divides a^2 + b^2. Show that (a^2 + b^2) / (ab + 1) is the square of an integer.
problems.notes: Vieta jumping: for a >= b > 0 with a^2 + b^2 = k (ab + 1) the other root c = kb - a of the quadratic is 0 <= c < a; a strong induction on a + b ends at a zero, where k = a^2 or b^2
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero < x0 -> Z.zero < x1 -> Z.dvd (x0 * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)) (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH)) -> Ex Z (fun (x5 : Z) => x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) = (x5 * x5) * (x0 * x1 + Z.of_N (Npos XH)))

problems.name: n5_minus_n_div30
problems.text: For every integer n, 30 divides n^5 - n.
problems.notes: 6 divides n^3 - n, so n^5 - n = (n^3 - n)(n^2 + 1); 5 divides n^5 - n (Fermat); 6 and 5 are coprime
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.dvd (Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XI (XI (XI XH)))))) (x0 ^ Npos (XI (XO XH)) - x0)

problems.name: imo1964_p2
problems.text: Suppose a, b, c are the sides of a triangle. Prove that a^2 (b + c - a) + b^2 (c + a - b) + c^2 (a + b - c) <= 3abc.
problems.notes: over the integers (a special case of the real inequality); the difference 3abc - (left side) is exactly the expression of Schur's inequality (schur_nonneg), which needs only a, b, c >= 0
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), Z.zero < x0 -> Z.zero < x1 -> Z.zero < x2 -> x0 < x1 + x2 -> x1 < x2 + x0 -> x2 < x0 + x1 -> (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) * ((x1 + x2) - x0) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) * ((x2 + x0) - x1)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) * ((x0 + x1) - x2) <= ((Z.of_N (Npos (XI XH)) * x0) * x1) * x2

problems.name: fe_quadratic
problems.text: Determine all functions f : Z -> Z such that f(x + y) + f(x - y) = 2 f(x) + 2 f(y) for all integers x and y.
problems.answer: f(n) = c n^2 for an integer c
problems.notes: f(0) = 0 and f is even; with c = f(1) the pair f(n) = c n^2, f(n + 1) = c (n + 1)^2 goes up by f(n + 2) = 2 f(n + 1) + 2 f(1) - f(n); negative n by evenness
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z -> Z), (forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), x0 (x1 + x2) + x0 (x1 - x2) = Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0 x1 + Z.of_N (Npos (XO XH)) * x0 x2) <-> Ex Z (fun (x1 : Z) => forall (x2 : Z), x0 x2 = x1 * (x2 * x2))

problems.name: n4_n2_1_composite
problems.text: Prove that n^4 + n^2 + 1 is not a prime for any integer n > 1.
problems.notes: n^4 + n^2 + 1 = (n^2 + n + 1)(n^2 - n + 1) with both factors larger than 1
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), Z.one < x0 -> Not (Z.prime ((x0 ^ Npos (XO (XO XH)) + x0 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + Z.of_N (Npos XH)))

problems.name: ineq_a_plus_b_cubed
problems.text: For all non-negative integers a and b: (a + b)^3 <= 4 (a^3 + b^3).
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), Z.zero <= x0 -> Z.zero <= x1 -> (x0 + x1) ^ Npos (XI XH) <= Z.of_N (Npos (XO (XO XH))) * (x0 ^ Npos (XI XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XI XH))

problems.name: ineq_square_products
problems.text: For all integers a, b, c: a^2 b^2 + b^2 c^2 + c^2 a^2 >= abc (a + b + c).
problems.notes: x^2 + y^2 + z^2 >= xy + yz + zx for x = ab, y = bc, z = ca: the three squares (ab - bc)^2, (bc - ca)^2, (ca - ab)^2
problems.statement: forall (x0 : Z), forall (x1 : Z), forall (x2 : Z), ((x0 * x1) * x2) * ((x0 + x1) + x2) <= (x0 ^ Npos (XO XH) * x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) + x1 ^ Npos (XO XH) * x2 ^ Npos (XO XH)) + x2 ^ Npos (XO XH) * x0 ^ Npos (XO XH)
